objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-remote-services-allow-remote-assistance
objects.description: The following analytic detects modifications in the Windows registry to enable remote desktop assistance on a targeted machine. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry datamodel, specifically monitoring changes to the "Control\\Terminal Server\\fAllowToGetHelp" registry path. This activity is significant because enabling remote assistance via registry is uncommon and often associated with adversaries or malware like Azorult.
